name: Flood-Area-Segmentation
description: This dataset evaluates image semantic segmentation of flood areas. Each sample provides an image and a natural language prompt asking to segment flooded regions, with a corresponding ground-truth mask.
card_text: Flood-Area-Segmentation is a paired image and text dataset for segmenting flooded regions in images. Each of the 116 samples consists of a JPEG image (e.g., aerial or satellite view) and a fixed textual instruction, 'Segment out the flood area in the image.' The target output is a PNG segmentation mask that marks flood pixels. The data is designed for segmentation models that take an image and a task prompt as input and produce a dense binary prediction. Assumptions include that the prompt is invariant across samples and that the mask aligns spatially with the input image. The domain is remote sensing and disaster monitoring.

context.semantics: A short textual instruction asking the model to segment out the flood area in the provided image.

image.semantics: Reference to the input image that contains the flood scene to be segmented.

mask.semantics: Reference to the ground-truth segmentation mask image that marks flooded regions corresponding to the input image.

meta.meta_structure_description: Every sample has an input object with an image_file path and a prompt string, and an output object with a map_file path. The prompt is a short instruction to segment flood areas, the image_file references the source image, and the map_file references its corresponding segmentation mask. No other semantic components are present.
